prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE individual square memory-card illustration in a coordinated set of 30 recognizable cars.
Primary request: a beautiful high-quality finished COLOUR SKETCH of the single specified real car, with model-specific recognizable proportions.
Reference image role: STYLE, workmanship, ivory paper, natural colour and generous blank framing ONLY. Do not copy the reference subject or add an aircraft.
Style/medium: expert automotive illustrator's graphite and coloured-pencil drawing, fine confident graphite contours, visible layered pencil strokes, selective delicate cross-hatching, restrained transparent watercolour modelling, luminous paper highlights. Richly finished yet visibly drawn by hand, matching the reference. Neither photo nor CGI, cartoon, vector art or toy.
Composition: square 1:1 PNG at least 1024x1024. Exactly ONE complete car, ALL wheels, bumpers, mirrors and open doors if specified fully in frame. Keep the entire silhouette contained within the CENTRAL 74% of the square, at least 13% completely blank ivory paper on EVERY side. Centre the entire vehicle, including any raised doors. Car is upright on a level invisible surface, modestly elevated three-quarter viewpoint, no extreme perspective or page rotation. Large and clear at 100px thumbnail size. Correct wheelbase, coherent body and natural wheel alignment.
Backdrop: uniform warm ivory drawing paper with very subtle fine paper grain, otherwise completely blank to every edge. No scenery, floor line or vignette. Gentle soft upper-left daylight and coherent self-shading; only tiny contact shading at tyres, no large cast shadow.
Constraints: one car only; no people, driver, road, buildings, sky, smoke, speed lines, decorative splashes or other objects. NO text, letters, numbers, captions, signatures, watermark, border, brand lettering or model script ANYWHERE, including badges, tyres, license plates and racing numbers. Omit license plates or render them blank. Small NONLETTER geometric emblems may be subtly suggested. Identification relies on the car's shape and defining features.
Specific subject, appearance and viewpoint: 1967 Toyota 2000GT in warm ivory white, very long elegant low bonnet, tiny fastback coupe cabin, rounded front with two prominent lower glass-covered fixed driving lights, pop-up main headlights CLOSED, flowing rear haunches, fine chrome trim and period alloy wheels. FRONT three-quarter view, nose points LEFT.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: This is a SMALL DRAWING on a LARGE EMPTY SQUARE sheet. Show the whole car only 60% as wide as the page, with 20% blank paper at the left AND 20% at the right. EMPTY IVORY PAPER dominates the composition. The vehicle appears as a modest central illustration, not a full-frame hero car. No zooming in. Match the drawing style of the reference but make the vehicle EVEN SMALLER on the page.
Remove even tiny embossed model designations and decorative pseudo-lettering from body panels; leave badges without letters.
